definitions.explanation: A public display of works of art or items of interest.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}{展覧会|てんらんかい}を{開|ひら}く。
{美術|びじゅつ}{展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: {展覧会|てんらんかい}のチケットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought tickets to the exhibition.

notes:
{展覧会|てんらんかい} refers to a public exhibition, typically of art or cultural items.

COMMON TYPES:
- {美術|びじゅつ}{展覧会|てんらんかい}: art exhibition
- {写真|しゃしん}{展覧会|てんらんかい}: photography exhibition
- {書道|しょどう}{展覧会|てんらんかい}: calligraphy exhibition

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}く: to go to an exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}に{出品|しゅっぴん}する: to exhibit at a show

ABBREVIATION:
Often shortened to {展|てん} in compounds: {美術展|びじゅつてん} (art exhibition)

RELATED:
- {展示|てんじ}: display, exhibition
- {美術館|びじゅつかん}: art museum
